blocks.text: 35 questions: five from each of the 7 chapters, in a random order.

Your first answer to each question is the one that counts. 90% or better passes, and passing earns the badge for Counting Things. You can take it as often as you like; the questions are dealt afresh each time.

topics.title: один, два, три, четыре: with nouns and in every case

exercises.q: Эти три ___ (звезда, gen. sg.) формируют Пояс Ориона.
exercises.prompt: These three stars form the Belt of Orion.

exercises.q: Два ___ (город, gen. sg.) соединяет это высокоскоростное шоссе.

exercises.q: В США пятьдесят ___ (штат, gen. pl.).

topics.title: Much, many, few, how many, several

exercises.q: Азиаты едят много ___ (рис, gen. sg.).

exercises.q: Много ___ (вода, gen. sg.) утекло с тех пор.
